summaries.title: Giving Robots a Hand: Learning Generalizable Manipulation with Eye-in-Hand Human Video Demonstrations
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**具身智能与物理AI**（Embodied & VLA）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限」痛点，作者围绕 **Giving Robots a Hand** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖具身智能与物理AI（Embodied & VLA）。核心论点主张：However, for robotic imitation, it is still expensive to have a human teleoperator collect large amounts of expert demonstrations with a real robot。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：On a suite of eight real-world tasks involving both 3-DoF and 6-DoF robot arm control, our method improves the success rates of eye-in-hand manipulation policies by...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **58%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（On a suite of eight real-world tasks involving both 3-DoF and 6-DoF robot arm control, our method improves the success rates of eye-in-hand manipulation policies by 58% (absolute) on...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 3 赞），本工作为突破 **人形控制与真机灵巧操作 (Humanoid & Manip)** 中的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
